text:
sara: hit a dup-on-retry while walking new hires through the sample SDK tutorial. sequence: call /embed -> token expired mid-call -> SDK did immediate retry -> server saw two create events.

tom: are we sure it was a 429 and not a 401 reauth loop?

sara: 429 in logs: `transport: 429 during refresh` immediately followed by `client: retrying req=onboard-42`. webhook received payload twice.

nitya: sample intentionally omitted idempotency header for simplicity but that bites us. two fixes: add Idempotency-Key header in sample; add small randomized backoff if the retry follows a token refresh.

tom: prefer sample enable replay guard by default so workshops don't regress. SDK should expose replayGuard opt-in. document in onboarding/README.

sara: i'll open a small PR to sampleapp with header + simulate-429 script to reproduce locally. will include a unit test that uses a fake clock so it's not flaky.

nitya: add telemetry metric dx.replay_guard.blocked_duplicate with only req id. Avoid payload contents.

tom: file parity issues for node/python: node currently injects a 50ms jitter; python retries immediately. open parity tickets.
sara: PR link once created. timeline: patch today, smoke in staging tomorrow.

(dx-bot): created ticket DX-904, labeled "dx/dup-on-429", linked to PR when available.
